verdict.rationale: Modal's own marketing documents parallel fan-out and async batch processing over many workloads at once: thousands of GPUs, and creating or running up to 1M Sandboxes concurrently. That is the platform's analog of bulk operations across many items. The evidence is homepage-level claims only, with no API reference showing how a user submits or manages a bulk set of items. missing for 10: documented bulk/map API for applying an operation across many inputs, details on per-item results and error handling, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Spawn async batch processing and long-running work in the background.
Fan out over thousands of GPUs, fully parallel, no job orchestration to manage.
Create over a million Sandboxes in under a minute, and run up to 1M concurrently.
